system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: WINWORD.EXE opened C:\Users\maria.lopez\Downloads\Statement.docm, and immediately spawned PowerShell with no profile, a hidden window, and an encoded command.
The encoded PowerShell command decodes to an expression that downloads and executes a script using IEX and WebClient.DownloadString from raw.githubusercontent.com/harbor-dental-it/tools/main/u.ps1.
The proxy recorded a successful GET for that u.ps1 URL, initiated by the same PowerShell process shortly after it started.
PowerShell then launched rundll32.exe to call Init in C:\Users\maria.lopez\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll; the evidence does not establish the DLL's contents.
The PowerShell process ended at 13:42:41 UTC, consistent in timing with the reported brief window, although the logs do not establish what was visible on screen.
At 13:43 UTC, DC-HD-01 recorded a Kerberos request for maria.lopez from 10.30.10.24, followed by a network logon to WS-MLOPEZ-01 identifying WS-LPARK-01 as the workstation.

At 13:51–13:52 UTC, a SYSTEM PowerShell process on WS-MLOPEZ-01 ran C:\Scripts\backup-check.ps1 and attempted explicit authentication as svc-claimsync; the inventory places that service account's job on FILE-HD-01.
At 14:13 UTC, maria.lopez also ran PowerShell with ExecutionPolicy Bypass from a local patch-audit.ps1 script; the available evidence does not establish whether this activity was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports that WS-LPARK-01 winsec and Sysmon logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. The destination-side logon record identifies WS-LPARK-01, but source-host activity during that interval cannot be reviewed (T013-00108).

The evidence includes a successful proxy GET for u.ps1 but not the returned script body; it also records execution of svchelper.dll without the DLL contents. The payload behavior therefore cannot be determined from these records (T013-00082, T013-00086).
claims_not_established: The exact behavior, persistence, or impact of u.ps1 or svchelper.dll.
